$comment: PROPOSAL, NOT A DROP-IN CONFIGURATION. Produced by the two-year audit of
2,357 gated trades and 88,945 ungated signals over Nifty 500 daily candles,
Nothing here is validated enough to trade. Three of four strategies read
monthly features that had not completed when the signal fired, so their
historical record is not evidence. Every 'enabled' flag below is therefore
false, and every recommendation carries the confidence the data supports
rather than the confidence a configuration file usually implies.
The correct sequence is: fix blocking_defects, re-run the backtest and the
ungated capture, then revisit this file with results that mean something.

blocking_defects.detail: Resamples the full daily frame into calendar months and patches only the final month to be point-in-time. Every earlier bar sees its own month's eventual high, low and close.
blocking_defects.fix: Compute the monthly aggregate as-of each evaluation date, not once over the whole frame.
blocking_defects.verification: A test that computes a feature on a truncated frame and on the full frame and requires equality at the truncation point.

blocking_defects.detail: Today's Nifty 500 constituent CSV is applied to the whole history. Demoted names are absent; promoted names are present for periods when they were not members.
blocking_defects.fix: Store index membership with effective dates from today forward; the past cannot be recovered.

blocking_defects.detail: Assumes a fill at exactly the stop price. 109 of 1,599 stop-outs (6.8%) opened below the stop; realistic fill on those averaged -9.74% against -7.00% modelled, worst -19.41%.
Nothing adjusts for splits or bonuses. Unadjusted history would manufacture false breakdowns and false volume spikes.
blocking_defects.fix: Reconcile known 2024-2026 split dates against stored candles.

evidence.method: Average R by score band across 88,945 ungated signals; the ordering reproduces within each year separately.
evidence.not_an_exit_artefact: High-score signals show LOWER favourable excursion (+8.71% vs +9.77%), the same adverse excursion, and a higher stop rate (68.0% vs 61.6%).
evidence.withdrawn_claim: On the one-year sample the 90-94 band looked profitable (+28.9R / 73 trades). Across two years it is -37.4R in year one and +24.0R in year two. Regime, not edge.

score_footprint.note: Consistent, but pointing the wrong way — higher is worse.

strategies.note: Largest contributor to both signal count and loss. Its record cannot be read until the look-ahead is fixed.
The only strategy positive in both years gated (+0.316 / +0.324 R), but on 26 and 17 trades. Contaminated by one monthly field. Worth re-testing first after the fix.
The only strategy with no look-ahead, and therefore the only one whose result is evidence. It loses money. This is the most trustworthy negative finding in the audit.
17 of 17 winners at exactly 2.970R, and 62.4% wins at 3R ungated. This is what a strategy looks like when it can see the end of the month, not an edge.

filters.description: Reject signals extended more than ~1 ATR above the 200 EMA.
filters.caveat: The only relationship in the dataset that reproduces across two disjoint years. Still only +0.12R before slippage — useful as a filter, not as a strategy.
Positive in both years but not clearly additive — it improved year two and slightly weakened year one.

filters.evidence: Quintile spreads of +0.038, +0.062 and +0.058 R; relvol flips direction between years.

feature_screen.$comment: Average R in the bottom vs top quintile of each field, over 88,945 ungated signals. 'years_agree' is the only column that separates a relationship from a coincidence. Signals overlap heavily, so these are screens, not significance tests.
feature_screen.interpretation: Every consistent feature says the same thing: extension predicts underperformance, pullback depth predicts the opposite. The system is built to buy strength; over this window strength was the wrong side.

exit_rules.recommendation: Volatility-scaled stop and a target placed near the observed favourable excursion rather than a fixed 3R. Exact values pending the stop-placement study.

not_assessed.$comment: Requested by the brief; the data cannot support them. Listed so nothing here is mistaken for a gap in the analysis rather than a gap in the data.
not_assessed.timeframe_comparison: only daily candles stored; weekly and monthly are derived
not_assessed.parameter_sweeps: thresholds hard-coded in strategy_signal(); must be parameterised first
not_assessed.sharpe_sortino_cagr: backtest records R, not portfolio equity
not_assessed.monte_carlo: resampling a contaminated trade set produces confident nonsense
not_assessed.walk_forward_optimisation: blocked on monthly_lookahead; optimising on leaked data fits the leak
